description: Shared MCA-NITW Renovate preset for all MCA-NITW repos. Extend via: extends: ['github>mca-nitw/.github'].

Cadence: one grouped minor/patch PR plus one grouped major PR per repo in the first week of each month, auto-merged when CI is green. prConcurrentLimit 1 serialises them so they never pile up. Security fixes ignore the schedule and all limits by design.

separateMajorMinor is deliberately left at its default (true). It takes priority over packageRule groups, which is why majors get their own PR. Do NOT set it to false: one blocked major (Babel 8 against react-scripts, TypeScript 7 against typescript-eslint in Sept 2026) would then hold every minor and patch hostage for the whole month.

lockFileMaintenance is off. It was a third monthly PR stream and the grouped update already refreshes in-range lock entries. It also produced PRs whose lockfile predated the base branch, which read as mergeable while actually being out of sync with package.json.
Kept intentionally identical to github>Sagargupta16/shared-workflows apart from the first-week schedule, so both fleets behave the same way.
